name: monitor-agent-nvidia
description: Monitor Agent pushes host metrics (CPU, memory, network, array disks, ZFS pools, Docker containers, and NVIDIA GPU stats via nvidia-smi) to your Monitor dashboard. Requires an ingest token from https://monitor.fascinated.cc Install the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin before using this template. This image uses the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (--runtime=nvidia --gpus=all) so nvidia-smi and driver libraries match your host. For AMD or Intel GPUs, use the default monitor-agent template instead (sysfs, no NVIDIA runtime).

paths.name: Host Root
paths.description: Host filesystem (read-only) for disk usage on array shares and ZFS mount points.

paths.name: Host /proc
paths.description: Host procfs for CPU, memory, load, and network metrics.

paths.name: Host /dev
paths.description: Host devices for disk I/O and ZFS (zpool).

variables.name: Ingest Token
variables.description: Ingest token from your Monitor server settings (required).

variables.name: Push Schedule
variables.description: Cron schedule with seconds field (default: every 15 seconds).

variables.name: Enable Docker Stats
variables.description: Collect per-container CPU and memory from the host Docker daemon.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Agent log level: debug, info, warn, or error.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone (e.g. America/New_York). Leave empty to use the Unraid system timezone.

variables.name: Config File
variables.description: Set to - to configure via environment variables only.

variables.name: Host Root Prefix
variables.description: Path prefix for host disk metrics (must match the Host Root volume target).
